method: Built-in imagegen image editing (not API mode), one edit per source photograph.
style: Previously approved gentle realistic color instant-film, borderless and without text.
note: Generative image editing preserves the overall scene but may change fine details; this is not a pixel-identical conventional color filter. Originals were not overwritten.

images.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer with strict photographic scene preservation. IMAGE 1 is the ONLY EDIT TARGET, an original wildlife photograph. IMAGE 2 is ONLY the previously approved gentle instant-color film rendering reference; NEVER copy its animal, pose, reeds, water or composition. Apply matching mild photographic COLOR GRADING and fine film texture to image 1. Deliver exactly ONE full-bleed landscape photograph, same entire original framing and aspect ratio, no square crop or zoom, no paper, white border, text, labels, UI or montage. LOCK original animal count, identities, anatomies, proportions, facial expressions, eyes, mouth and paws, wet/dry fur patterns, tails, relative positions, scale in frame, actions, occlusions, all vegetation, debris, reflections, water structure and lighting direction. Do not add/delete/move any scene elements or change pose. Do not invent anatomical detail or replace the animals with cuter/sharper versions. Maintain existing optical focus/depth and atmospheric context. Approved look: moderately deeper but readable shadows, very subtle cool blue-gray shadow color, natural warm brown fur, softened/nuanced green and electric-blue saturation, creamy smooth highlight rolloff without losing detail, subtly soft photographic microcontrast instead of artificial digital sharpness, delicate fixed organic fine film grain, very restrained broad corner shading. Preserve genuine differences in natural light and water color between sources: gray/brown or olive water should stay gray/brown or olive, not become uniformly blue. Same refined fresh instant-film character as reference 2, NOT heavy aged film. No scratches, dirt, orange leaks, heavy purple/cyan casts, strong vignette, painting, brushwork, drawing, fake glow, bloom haze, false shallow depth of field, artificial background replacement, excessive HDR or sharpened synthetic fur. Keep eyes/noses and important species details readable but preserve source softness. Output high-resolution, realistic photographic edit.
Original dimensions 3000 x 1688, wide roughly 16:9. A SINGLE upright rounded brown muskrat centered slightly left, facing camera while eating a clump of wet vegetation held in both forepaws. Its original eyes are small/squinty: do not make round big eyes or change face. Preserve the entire vegetation clump hanging from mouth/paws, dark horizontal object extending to its right at waterline, body reflection below, and extensive muted brown-gray reflective pond around it. Keep the original small relative animal size; no zoom, no stylized portrait, no invented limbs.
